steps.title: Initialize the ModernCalc Android Project
steps.description: Set up the basic project structure for the ModernCalc app, defining the app name and package name.

steps.title: Define Project Structure and Dependencies
steps.description: Configure the app/build.gradle file with the specified SDK versions, build tools, and Java compatibility (Java 8).

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest for ModernCalc
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml file, declaring the application, main activity, and setting the app label and icon for ModernCalc.

steps.title: Design the Calculator UI Layout
steps.description: Create the activity_main.xml layout file, designing the user interface for the calculator, including display and button grid.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Display (TextView)
steps.description: Add a TextView to the layout to display input and results, ensuring it's appropriately styled and positioned.

steps.title: Create Number Buttons (0-9 and decimal)
steps.description: Add Button widgets for numbers 0-9 and the decimal point to the layout, arranging them in a grid.

steps.title: Create Operator Buttons (+, -, *, /)
steps.description: Add Button widgets for basic arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /) to the layout, ensuring clear visual separation.

steps.title: Implement Clear and Equals Buttons
steps.description: Add 'Clear' (C) and 'Equals' (=) buttons to the layout, completing the basic calculator interface.

steps.title: Set up MainActivity for UI Interaction
steps.description: Create the MainActivity.java file within the 'com.moderncalc.app' package, extending Activity and setting up the basic onCreate method.

steps.title: Implement Button Click Listeners in MainActivity
steps.description: Initialize and attach OnClickListener interfaces to all calculator buttons in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Develop Number and Operator Input Logic
steps.description: Implement the logic within the click listeners to handle number input and store selected operators in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Core Calculation Logic
steps.description: Add the necessary methods and variables in MainActivity.java to perform arithmetic calculations based on the selected operator.

steps.title: Handle Decimal Point Input
steps.description: Ensure the decimal button correctly appends a decimal point to numbers, preventing multiple decimal points in a single number in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Clear Functionality
steps.description: Code the 'Clear' button's action to reset the display and all calculation variables to their initial state in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Equals Functionality and Display Result
steps.description: Finalize the 'Equals' button's logic to trigger the calculation, format the result, and update the display TextView in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Add Basic Error Handling
steps.description: Implement checks for common issues like division by zero, displaying appropriate messages to the user in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Validate UI and Functionality
steps.description: Review the layout and code to ensure all buttons are responsive, calculations are accurate, and the UI is visually appealing for ModernCalc.

steps.title: Building ModernCalc
steps.description: Compile the ModernCalc app using Gradle to generate a debug APK.
